subject.title: feat(gateway): add context engine control API

question: Should OpenClaw expose context-engine status, doctor, and rotate as a core Gateway/plugin control API after the session-targeting blocker is fixed?
rationale: The PR creates a new public Gateway surface and optional ContextEngine plugin contract; the canonicalization bug is mechanical, but the permanent control API and admin rotate scope require maintainer product/API intent.

options.title: Approve after scoping fix
options.body: Keep the proposed core API direction, but require canonical session targeting, focused regression tests, and maintainer-reviewed scope/docs semantics before merge.

options.title: Narrow the control surface
options.body: Land only read-scoped capabilities/status/doctor first and defer admin rotate until maintainers are ready to own that operator action.

options.title: Defer to plugins
options.body: Pause or close the core PR and keep context-engine maintenance control on plugin/private surfaces until a broader Gateway control contract is designed.

recommendation.title: Approve after scoping fix
recommendation.body: Keep the proposed core API direction, but require canonical session targeting, focused regression tests, and maintainer-reviewed scope/docs semantics before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses Gateway session ownership and context-engine boundaries where current-main history points to this routing/session area merger.
